title: GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini retire from Codex on August 31
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT & Codex changelog
why_it_matters: August 31 is the cutoff date for GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini in ChatGPT sign-in Codex flows, so hidden defaults and old task templates can become runtime failures.
actionable_takeaway: Run a Cutoff-Day Model Audit across defaults, automations, custom agents, scheduled tasks, CLI config, scripts and docs before accepting the day as complete.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.151.0 adds MCP result inspection, plugin catalog handling and sandbox hardening
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The release adds optional MCP discovery grace configuration, extension inspection or replacement of MCP tool results, per-repository plugin catalog handling, permission profile preservation and remote sandbox path hardening.
actionable_takeaway: Before upgrading Codex, test MCP result inspection, plugin catalog diffs, restored permission profiles, remote sandbox path semantics and root-goal budget accounting.

title: Codex extensions can inspect or replace MCP tool results before model ingestion
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: Tool outputs are a risk surface for prompt injection, secret leakage, unsafe links and malformed errors; inspecting results before they reach the model closes a gap left by input-only approval.
actionable_takeaway: Add an MCP Tool Result Inspection Gate with result schemas, field allowlists, redaction, withheld states and regression tests for sensitive or adversarial outputs.

title: Work with more websites in ChatGPT Work and Codex
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: Local browser, Site tools(WebMCP), cloud browser sign-in and public-web reading have different account, permission and evidence boundaries.
actionable_takeaway: For every web task, declare lane, account boundary, allowed actions, readback method and stop conditions before opening the page.

title: Scheduled tasks can respond to app updates and be shared
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Work scheduled tasks can respond to Gmail, Slack and GitHub activity and be shared as independent copies, changing automations from time-only reminders into event-driven workflows.
actionable_takeaway: Write a Trigger Envelope for each event task: source app, payload schema, idempotency key, owner, permissions, duplicate handling and approval boundary.

title: Import and sync plugin marketplaces from GitHub
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Marketplace sync can bring plugin updates into a workspace while app connection and identity review remain separate risk gates.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain a Marketplace Auto-Update Gate with source repo, allowlist, version pin, permission diff, owner, test workspace and rollback path.

title: Use Apple Messages from Codex and ChatGPT Work
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Messages integration turns assistant work from local text generation into real external communication, where read, draft and send must be separate states.
actionable_takeaway: Adopt a Cross-App Send Approval Ledger for read/search, draft, recipient confirmation, send approval and post-send evidence.

title: ChatGPT release notes add session visibility, app directory language and Codex computer-use expansion
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Session visibility, app-directory wording, computer-use expansion and remote steering all reinforce that control device and execution host are different evidence planes.
actionable_takeaway: Update the Agent Session Policy Matrix with host device, control device, data boundary, retention, permissions and final completion evidence.

title: GitHub Copilot cloud agent, github.com Chat and GitHub Mobile converge into one policy
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub plans unified policy and billing behavior for cloud agent, github.com Chat and Mobile, which affects default enablement, retention and review effort.
actionable_takeaway: Review organization policy, mobile access, retention, sandbox behavior, billing impact and review effort before the policy switch.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases add workbench controls and continuity features
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Shared sessions, Customize tab, CLI defaults, session restore, cross-agent continuity and model usage visibility all point to agent workbenches becoming managed operating surfaces.
actionable_takeaway: Record defaultMode, defaultPermissionMode, restore behavior, plugin/MCP surface, skills and model usage for every repeatable agent workbench.

title: Copilot code review expands to bot-authored and very large pull requests
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: AI-authored and large PRs can receive Copilot review, so teams need independence and risk evidence rather than a binary reviewed/not-reviewed flag.
actionable_takeaway: Add an Author/Reviewer Independence Gate with author type, reviewer type, tests, affected risk areas and resolution reason.

title: Enterprise-managed settings support autoUpdate for plugin marketplaces
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Auto-updating plugin marketplaces turn plugin distribution into a recurring deployment channel controlled by allowlists and managed settings.
actionable_takeaway: Treat autoUpdate like deployment: restrict known marketplaces, inspect daily diffs, watch new write actions and keep disable or rollback steps.

title: Global model policy is generally available for GitHub Copilot
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Models can inherit global policy unless explicitly enabled or disabled, making default delegation a material governance decision.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain a Model Policy Matrix with enabled, disabled, inherited and never-default states plus owner, rollout date and exception handling.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Python 0.22.0 hardens guardrails and usage accounting
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The release redacts blocked tool outputs from replay state, raises terminal failed/incomplete responses, rejects conflicting provider configuration and isolates RunState usage accounting.
actionable_takeaway: Before upgrading agent runtimes, add tests for output redaction, terminal failure, explicit-client conflicts, checkpoint usage isolation and nested-agent aggregation.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK JS 0.17.0 adds output-guardrail replay safety
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The JS SDK fails closed for ambiguous serialized approval checkpoints and replaces rejected final tool output in SDK-owned replay surfaces.
actionable_takeaway: For JS agents, prefer live RunState continuation over ambiguous replay and verify that rejected tool output cannot re-enter persisted state.

title: Agent Fleet brings CLI agents into Obsidian vaults as markdown-run workspaces
author: Obsidian Community
why_it_matters: Obsidian plugins are turning vaults into agent control surfaces where agents, skills, tasks and run logs can live as markdown files.
actionable_takeaway: Use a Vault-Agent Ownership Fence: read/search first, write only to approved folders, require backup and diff before move/delete/merge automation.
